title: Model reduction in time: Learning flow maps for reducing stochastic dynamical systems in time
abstract: arXiv:2610.35504v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predictions with dynamical systems can be computationally expensive---even with reduced models---because reaching future prediction times can require many sequential time integration steps. We propose Flow-Map First-Order Trajectory Matching (FM-FTM), a nonintrusive model reduction approach that accelerates ensemble predictions of stochastic dynamical systems by learning flow maps that replace multiple time-integration steps. Our method uses first-order trajectory matching (FTM) to learn a deterministic representation of the stochastic probability-current dynamics and then reduces its evolution over time into a flow map whose evaluation directly yields predictions over long time horizons. Numerical experiments on evolution problems with stochastic forcing demonstrate that FM-FTM accelerates ensemble predictions by up to two orders of magnitude while accurately predicting time marginals and ensemble statistics.

translated_title: 时间上的模型降阶：学习流映射以在时间维度上对随机动力系统进行降阶
translated_abstract: 使用动力系统进行预测在计算上可能非常昂贵——即使使用了降阶模型——因为要到达未来的预测时间点往往需要许多连续的时间积分步骤。我们提出了流映射一阶轨迹匹配方法（FM-FTM），这是一种非侵入式的模型降阶方法，通过学习能够替代多个时间积分步骤的流映射，来加速随机动力系统的集合预测。我们的方法首先使用一阶轨迹匹配（FTM）学习随机概率流动力学的确定性表示，然后将其随时间的演化缩减为一个流映射，对该流映射的评估可直接产生长时间范围上的预测。针对具有随机强迫的演化问题的数值实验表明，FM-FTM 能够将集合预测加速高达两个数量级，同时能够准确预测时间边际分布和集合统计量。
tldr: 提出非侵入式模型降阶方法FM-FTM，通过学习流映射替代多个时间积分步骤，将随机动力系统的集合预测加速高达两个数量级，同时准确预测时间边际分布与集合统计量。
en_tdlr: FM-FTM is a nonintrusive model reduction approach that learns flow maps to replace multiple time-integration steps, accelerating ensemble predictions of stochastic dynamical systems by up to two orders of magnitude while accurately predicting time marginals and ensemble statistics.
